item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry replenishment of the winter monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today. The weather will improve over the region. With the monsoon persisting, it will be generally fine over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be cold in the morning and at night.

Date/Month: 19/12 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches at first. Cool in the morning and at night. Dry with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 20 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
